lines.text: Footnotes
Terms and Conditions apply. Please refer to the respective product summaries for more information.
1. Coverage against death and terminal illness up to policy anniversary immediately after the 99th birthday of the life insured.
2. Total premiums paid include total basic premiums paid plus any top-up premiums, less any withdrawals.
3. Welcome Bonus will be given in the form of additional units at a rate based on the first 12 months regular basic premiums paid, excluding
top-up premiums. The additional units are payable according to your pre-specified basic premium allocation.
4. A one-time Annual Premium Bonus will be given for selected MIP options (not applicable to MIP 5 Years Flexi 1, MIP 6 Years Flexi 2 and MIP 7
Years Flexi 5) if the first regular basic premium is paid via annual premium payment mode. The Annual Premium Bonus (if applicable) will be
given in the form of additional units at a rate based on the first annual regular basic premium paid, and the MIP option selected. If there is any
change in the mode of premium payment from annual to non-annual during the premium shortfall period, the Annual Premium Bonus will be
deducted from the account value.
5. Loyalty Bonus will be given during the policy term starting from the policy anniversary immediately after the end of the MIP and every policy
anniversary thereafter, in the form of additional units based on 0.3% of the account value (not applicable to MIP 5 Years Flexi 1 and MIP 6 Years
Flexi 2).
6. Flexibility to vary the regular basic premium from the flexi start date of the respective plan(s).
7. Applicable only to Manulife InvestReady (III) SGD.
8. Applicable to Manulife InvestReady (III) Plus and Manulife InvestReady (III) SGD (except MIP 5 Years Flexi 1).
9. Any dividends from dividend-paying funds will be reinvested during MIP. After MIP, customers have the option to either continue reinvesting
potential dividends or withdraw potential dividends from dividend-paying funds.
10. Subject to the distribution rate and frequency of the chosen InvestReady funds. The dividend will be paid either in SGD or USD depending on
the currency of your chosen plan. The issuance of dividends remains at the discretion of the relevant fund manager and is not guaranteed.
11. Step-up Booster Bonus will be given when all conditions are met:
(i) effective account value (i.e. account value plus sum of partial withdrawals, dividends payout (if any), and cost of insurance deducted)
at the end of MIP and at the end of each policy year thereafter, until the end of policy term, is equal or lower than total regular basic
premiums plus any top-up premiums;
(ii) regular basic premiums are paid in full before flexi start date; and
(iii) policy is in force at the point of bonus payment.
12. Starting from policy year 6 and before the end of MIP, the partial withdrawal charge will be waived if the partial withdrawal is due to a life
stage event. The maximum limit for each request is 20% of the account value, minus past life stage partial withdrawals.
13. Refers to any of the following life stage events:
(i) when the life insured attains age 21 or 65;
(ii) when the life insured or life insured’s child enrolls in tertiary education;
(iii) when there is any change of marital status of the life insured, such as when the life insured marries, divorces or becomes a widow;
(iv) when the life insured becomes a parent by having a newborn child or legally adopting a child; or
(v) when the life insured purchases a residential property.
14. The partial withdrawal charges [ranging from 100% (in the first 2 policy years) to 8%] apply if partial withdrawal is made during MIP. The
partial withdrawal charges will be deducted from the partial withdrawal amount, with the remaining amount paid to you. For clarity, partial
withdrawal charges do not apply to the payment of dividends or to the withdrawal of any accumulated reinvested dividends.
15. The prevailing top-up charge is 0%. Manulife reserves the right to vary the charge and will give you advance notice.
16. Applicable to MIP 10 Years Flexi 3, MIP 10 Years Flexi 5, MIP 10 Years Flexi 8 and MIP 13 Years Flexi 10 (MIP 13 Years Flexi 10 is not applicable
to InvestReady (III) USD) in the low annualised premium band.
17. The maximum Step-up Booster Bonus payable varies with policy duration.
